recipes.title: Dairy-Free 100-Calorie Fudgy Brownies
steps: Stir the applesauce, nut butter, cocoa powder, sweetener, vanilla and salt together until smooth and glossy.
Spread into a parchment-lined 8×8 in (20 cm) pan and bake at 350 °F (175 °C) for about 25 minutes, until set at the edges but still a little wobbly in the middle.
Let cool completely so they firm up and turn fudgy, then cut into 9 squares.
recipes.notes: The video names the ingredients but not the amounts — quantities, bake time and macros (other than her stated ~100 cal per brownie) are estimates. No flour, no dairy, no cottage cheese.
